row: Hello! I first created this channel to help share my journey to creating a deeper relationship with my horses. I want to share with you how working on myself, I was able to finally achieve a better, more connected relationship with my animals. I then dove into equine therapy and found how interconnected everything is! I'm a certified massage therapist, Musculoskeletal Unwinding Practitioner, MFR, and I also do Reiki Healing and RedLight Therapy.
